summary: AFS SenSub Corp., as depositor, and AmeriCredit Financial Services (d/b/a GM Financial), as sponsor, filed an 8-K reporting an agreement to cause GM Financial Consumer Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-4 to issue asset-backed notes: $198.0M Class A-1 at 4.258%, $280.61M Class A-2-A at 4.78%, $75.0M floating-rate A-2-B, $355.61M A-3 at 5.26%, $74.18M A-4 at 5.36%, $16.71M Class B at 5.54%, $15.67M Class C at 5.64%, plus a certificate, closing October 14, 2026, collateralized by prime auto loan receivables, sold via SMBC Nikko and co-managers. This is a routine ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle, though investors may note credit-enhancement subordination and floating-rate tranche pricing.
